prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 多级表头 · 半年度指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "指标" spans 1 col × 2 row; "2023 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "2024 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "备注" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "2023 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "2023 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "2024 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "2024 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 349px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示营收、毛利率和研发投入在 2023 年与 2024 年各半年的变化，并用备注补充背景。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较四个半年度数值，最后查看同一行的备注；也可纵向扫描某一半年的各项指标。备注较长的行产生的行高可容纳同一行指标名称的换行。","groups":["第 2、3 列同属 2023 年，第 4、5 列同属 2024 年；四列都是半年度数值，应保持一致的宽度和比较节奏。","第 1 列是行标题，第 6 列是对应行的文字说明；两者分别承担识别和解释作用。"],"keep_intact":["半年度标签、数值及百分号应保持完整，避免拆行。","指标名称中的单位“亿元”应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["备注中的中文说明可自然换行，尤其是营业收入一行。","空间紧张时，较长的指标名称可在名称与单位之间换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [144, 69, 69, 69, 69, 299] · table 720×206px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [125, 66, 66, 66, 66, 330] · table 720×252px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 4/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [150, 75, 75, 75, 75, 269] · table 720×206px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"四个半年度列等宽，表头、数值和指标名称均保持完整；各行容易横向阅读。长备注换成两行，其余备注保持一行，整体紧凑。","problems":"营业收入的备注第一行末尾留下数字“1.2”，第二行才出现“个百分点”，数量与单位被分开，阅读略有停顿。","cause":"备注列为 299px，可用文字宽度为 278px，恰好在“1.2”之后换行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"备注列较宽，长备注的换行位置较自然；四个数值列仍保持等宽。","problems":"四个半年度表头都被拆成两行；两项指标名称中的“亿元”也被拆开。表头和数据行因此增高，削弱了横向比较的节奏。","cause":"半年度列各为 66px，可用文字宽度仅 45px，不足以容纳宽约 46px 的标签；指标列为 125px，也不足以容纳最长的完整名称。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"表头、数值和指标名称完整，四个半年度列等宽；长备注的“1.2 个百分点”留在同一行，数量与单位易于连读。","problems":"半年度列比内容所需更宽，空白分配偏多；备注列相应变窄，长备注的第二行较短，文字分布略不均衡。","cause":"四个半年度列各为 75px，共占 300px；备注列缩至 269px，可用文字宽度为 248px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[144,68,68,68,68,303],"change":"以 r0A 为基础，将四个半年度列各缩窄 1px，把节省的 4px 给备注；保留等宽比较节奏和完整指标名称，并尝试改善长备注的换行位置。"},{"name":"more-note-space","widths":[144,67,67,67,67,307],"change":"将四个半年度列收至按内容宽度计算可容纳表头的 67px，给备注更多空间；这是更紧凑的数值列方案，需要检查浏览器实际渲染是否仍能让表头完整显示。"},{"name":"unit-together","widths":[144,73,73,73,73,283],"change":"在 r0A 与 r0C 之间分配空间：维持完整指标名称和较从容的等宽数值列，同时扩大 r0C 的备注列，尝试保留数量与单位同一行并改善文字分布。"}]}
